name: Mass Ave Hair Studio
hoursText: Monday: closed, Tuesday-Friday: 9am to 7pm, Saturday: 8am to 4pm, Sunday: closed

profile.stylists: Rachel (owner, master stylist: balayage, blonding and color corrections), Marisol (senior stylist: curly cuts, silk presses, bilingual English/Spanish), Devon (stylist: men's cuts, fades and kids cuts), Kayla (stylist: extensions, blowouts and bridal styling).
profile.pricing: Prices are starting-at for short to shoulder-length hair. Hair past the shoulders or very thick hair adds $15-$40 on cuts and color, plus $10 per extra bowl of color. Rachel's services are about 20% higher than the menu. Consultations are free.
profile.color_policy: Every new color client needs a free 15-minute patch test at least 48 hours before their first color, lightening or keratin appointment. Color corrections and going more than 3 shades lighter require a free consultation first and may take more than one session.
profile.booking_policy: A $50 deposit holds color, balayage, extensions and any appointment over 2 hours; it goes toward the service. Please give 24 hours notice to cancel or reschedule - late cancellations and no-shows forfeit the deposit. Arriving more than 15 minutes late may mean shortening the service or rescheduling.
profile.products: Color: Redken Shades EQ and Wella. Bond builders: Olaplex and K18. Retail: Redken, Olaplex, Briogeo and Moroccanoil.
profile.policies: We accept cash, all major cards, Apple Pay and Venmo. Free street parking on the side streets and a paid lot behind the building. Walk-ins welcome for men's and kids cuts when a chair is open. Kids under 12 should come with an adult. We don't do perms or chemical relaxers. For color, please arrive with dry hair and no heavy product.
